analysis_plan.capital: negative chronological minimum of each episode's cash prefix, unlimited prefunding convention; per episode only, never a portfolio sum
analysis_plan.claims: displayed conditional evaluation of causally reachable states; no fill, executability, USD, collateral identity or profit claim; work caps are unknown, never negative
analysis_plan.entry: one global episode per maximal qualifying entry interval for each route and fee schedule; episode state changes restart only that episode's closure gates; an all-miss attempt with no state change cannot retry until its predicate is false then true
analysis_plan.fees: one schedule per replay with 0 <= f <= 1 and conversion fees >= 0; schedules enter every gate; zero fees optimistic; no component repricing
analysis_plan.gates: maximal half-open intervals of a continuously true predicate (key, support, economic test), evaluated at frames, liveness expiries and the episode's own state changes; qualification at start + 1000 ms strictly before the end; one evaluation per interval at qualification + 500 ms on the causal state only; frames at an instant precede evaluation; e = min(censoring stop, invalidation, window close) blocks any evaluation at or after it
analysis_plan.kernel: isolated decorated copy of the pinned live-v1 replay; its undecorated output must equal the unchanged kernel on the same records or the run is refused; added outputs: per-mark usable view, accepted source time and receipt time per coin
analysis_plan.retention: at most MAX_EPISODES episode objects per route and schedule; later decisions are counted as work_cap without allocation; each episode is reconciled and tallied as it ends; the trace keeps an exact encoded prefix within its cap
analysis_plan.units: conditional one-token granularity: displayed sizes floored to whole tokens for m and fills; admission needs integer m >= 1; quote-token cash only

bounds.cpu_ram: hard child limits (RLIMIT_AS, RLIMIT_CPU, wall kill); measured 150,291 records: 28.7 s CPU, +395 MB

claims: displayed conditional evaluation only; quote-token units; zero fees optimistic; no fill, executability, USD or profit claim; episode sums overlap and are never portfolio cash; caps are unknown, never negative

denominators.closure_within_window: (entry_closed + closed) / (filled + work_cap); upper adds censored_open, invalidated_open and work_cap
denominators.decision_to_fill: filled / (decisions - not_admitted_size - entry_censored); upper adds work_cap
denominators.decisions: qualifying entry intervals per route and schedule; null if the step cap ends the entry scan
